summary: Blue Bird filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a prospectus supplement to its automatic shelf Form S-3 (333-284017) covering resale of up to 2,702,180 common shares issuable on exchange, retraction or redemption of non-voting exchangeable shares of MB Exchangeco Inc., a Canadian subsidiary, held by a selling stockholder. The Exchangeable Shares trace to Blue Bird's April 1, 2026 acquisition of the remaining 50% Micro Bird joint-venture interest. The filing exists solely to file Smith, Gambrell & Russell's validity opinion as Exhibit 5.1; no terms, board recommendation or advisor are stated. Watch for resale overhang and Micro Bird integration execution.
